summary: Frontend-only verification of the Cut Pro Editor (bug fix: EDIT tab now surfaces transitions/music/format/effects/logo for cut versions). Seeded session for user_e2e_1788105676 (actual owner of experience f3f5a6a6 — note the review request incorrectly listed user_ded9f8fff749). Loaded /studio/f3f5a6a6, clicked EDIT tab. All 4 READY cut versions expose a prominent PRO EDIT button (data-testid=pro-edit-cut-{v}). Clicking opens the CutEditor modal (data-testid=cut-editor). Verified every requested control (cut-editor-preview, cut-aspect-16:9/9:16/1:1, cut-transition-none/fade/dissolve/smooth, cut-filter-cinematic/warm/cool/bw/vivid, cut-speed-0.5/1/2, cut-music, cut-logo-upload, cut-editor-apply, cut-editor-close). Music dropdown populated from GET /api/music with 4 library tracks (coastal-light, golden-hour, iris-night, sage-drift) plus 'No music' option. Aspect pill switches preview container class (9/16 confirmed). Filter pill applies CSS filter to preview video (bw -> grayscale(1) contrast(1.08)). Apply→new version with {aspect:9:16, filter:bw, transition:fade, music:iris-night, speed:1}: POST /api/cuts/{id}/pro-edit succeeded, modal auto-closed in ~10s, a new version card appeared (V5, kind=pro-edit, status ready, decision label 'pro-edit · 9:16 · bw · fade'). Regression: OrchestratorPanel (orchestrator-panel), 5 delete-cut buttons, and 8 remove-clip chips still present.

issues: Native <video> controls used inside modal (browser default); ok functionally but a themed player would match app aesthetics. Headless Chromium cannot decode the cut mp4, so preview area shows a black frame — expected per E1 note.

critical_code_review_comments: Review request had an incorrect owner mapping (said user_ded9f8fff749 owns f3f5a6a6, but DB shows owner is user_e2e_1788105676). Not a bug — informational.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted from Emergent devtools instrumentation that wraps dynamic children inside <option> with a <span data-ve-dynamic>. This is from the Emergent tooling overlay, not app code — safe to ignore in production build, but worth reporting upstream to the tooling team.
Filter pill list includes 'none' (index 0) but the initial state defaults to 'cinematic' — the 'none' pill therefore renders but users may expect it to be the default; low priority UX consideration.

rca of the issue: N/A — bug fix already implemented and verified working. The reported user complaint ('en Edit no sale nada de eso') is fully resolved: the EDIT tab of an experience now exposes a prominent PRO EDIT button on every ready cut version card, opening a CutEditor modal offering format (16:9/9:16/1:1), transition stock (none/fade/dissolve/smooth), color looks (cinematic/warm/cool/bw/vivid), speed, music library selection, and logo/watermark overlay — with live preview and Apply producing a new pro-edit cut version via FFmpeg.
